scripts.dev: npm run packages:build && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.packages:build: npm -w @hrms/shared run build && npm -w @hrms/zkteco run build
scripts.build: npm run packages:build && npm -w @hrms/api run build && npm -w @hrms/web run build && npm -w @hrms/connector run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run packages:build && npm -w @hrms/api run typecheck && npm -w @hrms/web run typecheck && npm -w @hrms/connector run typecheck
scripts.connector:build: npm run packages:build && npm -w @hrms/connector run build
